notes.title: v1.0.7 - MAJOR!!
notes.content:
[b]MAJOR UPDATE!!![/b]

New challenges await!
•	Unseen Revealer! Acquire and use the EYE OF RA to start the challenge!
•	A-Maze-Ing! Acquire and use the BUTTERFLY FIONKA to start the challenge!
•	Sight-Four! Acquire and use the BLUE GLASSES to start the challenge!
•	A reward for finishing all challenges! Go to the final chapter area to receive it!
•	New achievements added for the updated challenges!

MINOR BUGFIXES:
•	Minor bugfix in running animations slowdowns.
•	Minor bugfix in the 3rd cutscene where it may be unsavable.
•	Minor bugfix in checkpoints.

notes.title: v1.0.1
notes.content:
OPTIMIZATIONS
•	Optimized Audios.
•	Optimized Background Object Meshes.
•	Optimized Game Saves Mechanics.
•	Optimized Game Size.
•	Optimized Lighting Object-Based.
•	Optimized Meshed Objects.
•	Optimized Occlusion Culling.
•	Optimized Static Objects.
•	Optimized Textures.

FEATURES
•	Added Arabic Localized Achievements.
•	Added FPS Counter in Graphics/Accessibility Settings.
•	Added Game Startup Achievements Check.
•	Added Manual Save Game (JIC, game auto-saves seamlessly).
•	Added Marrow’s Voice volume control in audio settings.
•	Added Rain volume control in audio settings. 
•	Added support controller vibration for PS4, PS5, Xbox.
•	Added support controller vibration toggler in settings.

BUGFIXES
•	Deactivate optimization when cutscenes are on.
•	Density of Grass settings now control all terrain grasses.
•	Draw Distance settings now control all camera distances.
•	Fix: Audio BFX volume now control all BFX audios.
•	Fix: Audio SFX volume now control all SFX audios.
•	Fix: when dying player able to glitch-pause game.
•	Fixed the door’s code pad that leads to the blue house.
•	Fixed the Roll-Up door’s occlusion culling near the cottage.
•	Game Auto-Pauses when controller gets disconnected.
•	Game Auto-Pauses when launching Steam menus.
•	General bugfixes.
•	General performance improvements.
•	Improved metal doors sound effects.
•	Minor Achievements Improvements.
•	Minor crash fix.
•	Rain drop VFX bugfixes and performance improvements.
•	Redeclared “Subtitles” into “Interaction Subtitles” for clarity.
•	Vibration stops when quitting game.
